Security concerns in the Middle East. Imola waiting as the European backup.

Qatar remains "confirmed" — but everything is still on the table. F1's season finale is TBD.

#F1

x_posts.text:
If Qatar AND Abu Dhabi are cancelled, Antonelli wins the 2026 F1 title even earlier.

The championship math changes. The finale venue changes.

Domenicali's Sept. 15 deadline is today. Malaysia is already added. Imola is waiting.

Watch this space. #F1

stories.title: Antonelli Title Math — Singapore Earliest, São Paulo Most Likely

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Kimi Antonelli CANNOT clinch the 2026 F1 title at Baku.

81 points clear. 9 races, 233 pts left. Max gap after Azerbaijan: 106 pts with 208 available.

Earliest possible: Singapore.

Most realistic: São Paulo.

The finish line is coming. #F1

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
2026 #F1 Drivers' Championship after Madring:

1. Antonelli (Mercedes) — 292
2. Russell (Mercedes) — 211 (-81)
3. Hamilton (Ferrari) — 191 (-101)
4. Norris (McLaren) — 186 (-106)

9 races left. 233 pts available. This one's Antonelli's to lose.

stories.title: Williams "Almost Entirely New Car" at Baku

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Williams are bringing what James Vowles calls "an almost entirely new car" to Baku.

The FW48 arrived late, overweight, and has underperformed all season. 11 points, 8th in the constructors.

The Azerbaijan GP (Sept. 24-26) is Williams' line in the sand. #F1
